source_clause: LS4.) A short press of the (-, +) button will increase the lumbar/bolster by a small set amount, that would be equivalent to a short press of the previous 4-way rocker hard control (See CFTS044).
reasoning: 驗證目標：13.5（LS4.）短按 (-, +) 使腰靠／側靠增加一個級距。關鍵情境條件：依 19 §4.2 收窄 —— 級距之量值及與舊款 4-way rocker 之等效性由 CFTS044 擁有，不在範圍；依 R-C22，ER 不補任何量值，改用條文自身之動詞 increase／decrease（13.5 未使用 level 一詞，故不外推，20 §4）。為什麼這樣切：037 拆為「小級距增減」與「與 rocker 等效」兩個 leaf。刻意略過：-081-02 之區別內容純為上述委派，Action 與 -01 相同，扣除後無餘留 —— 依 20 §2.1 回報停下，待裁（見 split_reason）。

distinguishing_axis.delta: 037 之 -081-02 全文為「The system shall equivalent to short press of previous 4-way rocker hard control」，其 Verification Criteria 之 Action 與 -081-01 相同（Short press (-, +) button）。故本 leaf 之區別內容純為委派（CFTS044 所定之級距量值與等效性），扣除後於本 feature 範圍內**無餘留**。依 20 §2.1 回報停下，待裁

tcs.tc_title: Short press moves the lumbar level by one step
tcs.test_item: A short press of the (-, +) button will increase the lumbar/bolster by a small set amount
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is equipped with a lower screen that provides seat controls (13.2)
2. [spec-derived] The door control carries the seat control (-, +) buttons for lumbar and bolster (13.2)
3. [spec-derived] The popup or tab change has already been triggered, so the next press is applied (13.3)
4. [test-setup] The lumbar/bolster level is away from both its minimum and its maximum
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Record the lumbar/bolster state shown before the adjustment
2. Short press "+" on the door seat control
3. Short press "-" on the door seat control
tcs.expected_result:
1. The lumbar/bolster state shown before the adjustment is recorded
2. The lumbar/bolster is increased
3. The lumbar/bolster is decreased back to the state recorded in step 1
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

tcs.tc_title: Short press on the touch screen moves the level by one step
tcs.test_item: A short press will increase the lumbar/bolster by a small set amount, that would be equivalent to a short press of the previous 4-way rocker hard control
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle is equipped with a lower screen that provides seat controls (13.2)
2. [test-setup] The Seats tab is open and the lumbar/bolster level is away from both its minimum and its maximum
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Record the lumbar/bolster state shown before the adjustment
2. Short press "+" on the door seat control
3. Short press "-" on the door seat control
tcs.expected_result:
1. The lumbar/bolster state shown before the adjustment is recorded
2. The lumbar/bolster is increased
3. The lumbar/bolster is decreased back to the state recorded in step 1
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.split_reason: 037 將本節拆為兩個 leaf，本 leaf 之區別內容純為委派至外部 spec，於本 feature 範圍內扣除後無餘留。依 20 §2.1 回報停下，待裁；本 TC 之驗證目標暫同其 -01 sibling，不得視為已定案
